title: eugenia ayacuchae
intro: Eugenia ayacuchae, commonly known as the Ayacuchan Eugenia or Guanabobillo, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to help lower cholesterol levels and manage blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia ayacuchae include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia ayacuchae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
